GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.8 (4 Apr 46) CIE
(SCAPIN - 857)
APO 500
4 April 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Dismissal of MORISHITA, Saiichi, Chief of the Education Section, Kochi Prefecture.
The Imperial Japanese Government, on receipt of this Memorandum, will dismiss MORISHITA, Saiichi from the office of Chief of the Education Section, Kochi Prefecture and will prohibit his future employment by all Japanese educational institutions or agencies, either public or private.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
